description: The gate text and its decision block (openspec gate-full-context, design decision 4): text is the output of gateText in daemon/src/loop/agent.ts, body is the text that a screen shows next to the decisions. TypeScript (@aw/client/gates) and Kotlin (GateTexts.kt) run the same cases. Source: the output of gateText of awd, captured on 2026-11-23 with synthetic task texts. daemon/src/loop/units.test.ts fails when gateText gives another text.

cases.name: approach with 2 decisions
cases.text:
# Add rate limits

## Steps
1. Add a token bucket per API key.
2. Return 429.

## Decisions
1. Which limit per API key?
   Options: 100/min · 1000/min
   Recommended: 100/min
2. Where do we keep the counters?
   Options: In memory · Redis
   Recommended: Redis

"Confirm" accepts the recommended options. To choose another option, request changes with a comment.

decisions.question: Where do we keep the counters?
